5: /**
6:  * PlayerManager manages various player instances for all the sounds. It also
7:  * implements a callback for subscribing to sender application messages
8:  * (bindings in index.ts). Based on these messages, it loads various sounds and

10:  * timer that runs out on 5m of inactivity.
11:  */

14:   private static readonly FADE_IN_OUT_DURATION = 1500;
15:   private static readonly VOLUME_ADJUSTMENT_FADE_DURATION = 750;

17:   private players: Map<string, Howl> = new Map();
18:   private bufferingState: Set<string> = new Set();
19:   private idleTimer: number;

22:   constructor() {
23:     this.startIdleTimer();
24:   }
25: 
26:   /**
27:    * Starts a timer that invokes status callback with a
28:    * PlayerManagerStatusEvent.IdleTimedOut event on finish.
29:    */
30:   private startIdleTimer(): void {
31:     this.stopIdleTimer();
32:     this.idleTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
33:       this.notifyStatusUpdate(PlayerManagerStatus.IdleTimedOut);
34:     }, PlayerManager.IDLE_TIMEOUT);
35:   }
36: 
37:   /**
38:    * stops idle timer
39:    */
40:   private stopIdleTimer(): void {
41:     window.clearTimeout(this.idleTimer);
42:   }
43: 
44:   /**
45:    * initializes a new Howl instance with the given paramters.
46:    * @param soundKey soundKey as passed by the sender app
47:    * @param isLooping whether the sound should loop
48:    * @param volume initial volume for the sound
49:    */
50:   private createPlayer(
51:     soundKey: string,
52:     isLooping: boolean,
53:     volume: number
54:   ): Howl {
55:     this.bufferingState.add(soundKey);
56:     return new Howl({
57:       src: Sounds[soundKey.substring(0, soundKey.length - 4)],
58:       autoplay: false,
59:       html5: false,
60:       loop: isLooping,
61:       pool: 1,
62:       volume: volume,
63:       preload: true,
64:     });
65:   }
66: 
67:   /**
68:    * start playback for a player. It waits for the Howl instance to be ready and
69:    * sound to be loaded before starting playback. It invokes the status callback
70:    * with a PlayerManagerStatusEvent.Playing event when the sound starts playing.
71:    */
72:   private play(soundKey: string): void {
73:     if (this.players.has(soundKey) === false) {
74:       return;
75:     }
76: 
77:     const player = this.players.get(soundKey);
78:     if (player.playing() === false) {
79:       player.once("play", (): void => {
80:         this.bufferingState.delete(soundKey);
81:         this.notifyStatusUpdate(PlayerManagerStatus.Playing);
82:         // fade-in only looping sounds because non-looping sounds need to
83:         // maintain their abruptness thingy.
84:         if (player.loop()) {
85:           player.fade(0, player.volume(), PlayerManager.FADE_IN_OUT_DURATION);
86:         }
87:       });
88: 
89:       player.play();
90:     }
91:   }
92: 
93:   /**
94:    * Pauses the given player without destroying the Howl instance.
95:    */
96:   private pause(soundKey: string): void {
97:     if (this.players.has(soundKey) === false) {
98:       return;
99:     }
100: 
101:     const player = this.players.get(soundKey);
102:     const originalVolume = player.volume();
103:     player.fade(originalVolume, 0, PlayerManager.FADE_IN_OUT_DURATION);
104:     player.once("fade", () => {
105:       player.pause();
106:       player.volume(originalVolume);
107:     });
108:   }
109: 
110:   /**
111:    * Stops a given player if it is playing. It also releases the underlying
112:    * resources regardless of the player's playing state.
113:    */
114:   private stop(soundKey: string): void {
115:     if (this.players.has(soundKey) === false) {
116:       return;
117:     }
118: 
119:     const player = this.players.get(soundKey);
120:     this.players.delete(soundKey);
121:     this.bufferingState.delete(soundKey);
122:     if (player.playing()) {
123:       player.fade(player.volume(), 0, PlayerManager.FADE_IN_OUT_DURATION);
124:       player.once("fade", () => {
125:         player.stop();
126:         player.unload();
127:       });
128:     } else {
129:       player.stop();
130:       player.unload();
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   /**
135:    * Sets volume for the given player. If the player is currently playing, it
136:    * fades the volume instead to provide smooth transition.
137:    */
138:   private setVolume(soundKey: string, volume: number): void {
139:     if (this.players.has(soundKey) === false) {
140:       return;
141:     }
142: 
143:     const player = this.players.get(soundKey);
144:     if (player.playing()) {
145:       player.fade(
146:         player.volume(),
147:         volume,
148:         PlayerManager.VOLUME_ADJUSTMENT_FADE_DURATION
149:       );
150:     } else {
151:       player.volume(volume);
152:     }
153:   }
154: 
155:   isBuffering(): boolean {
156:     return this.bufferingState.size > 0;
157:   }
158: 
159:   /**
160:    * Implements the callback to handle messages received from the Sender
161:    * application. Based on the action taken, it invokes the status callback with
162:    * an appropriate PlayerManagerStatusEvent.
163:    */
164:   handlePlayerEvent(event: PlayerControlEvent): void {
165:     event.src.forEach((soundKey: string) => {
166:       if (this.players.has(soundKey) === false) {
167:         if (event.action === undefined || event.action === null) {
168:           return;
169:         }
170: 
171:         if (event.action !== PlayerAction.Create) {
172:           // shouldn't be here?
173:           return;
174:         }
175: 
176:         if (this.players.size === 0) {
177:           this.stopIdleTimer();
178:         }
179: 
180:         this.players.set(
181:           soundKey,
182:           this.createPlayer(soundKey, event.isLooping, event.volume)
183:         );
184: 
185:         this.notifyStatusUpdate(PlayerManagerStatus.Playing);
186:         return;
187:       }
188: 
189:       this.setVolume(soundKey, event.volume);
190:       switch (event.action) {
191:         case PlayerAction.Play:
192:           this.play(soundKey);
193:           break;
194:         case PlayerAction.Pause:
195:           this.pause(soundKey);
196:           break;
197:         case PlayerAction.Stop:
198:           this.stop(soundKey);
199:           break;
200:       }
201: 
202:       if (this.players.size === 0) {
203:         this.notifyStatusUpdate(PlayerManagerStatus.Idle);
204:         this.startIdleTimer();
205:       } else {
206:         this.notifyStatusUpdate(PlayerManagerStatus.Playing);
207:       }
208:     });
209:   }
210: 
211:   /**
212:    * helper function to invoke the event receiver callback.
213:    */
214:   private notifyStatusUpdate(event: PlayerManagerStatus): void {
215:     if (this.onStatusUpdateCallback) {
216:       this.onStatusUpdateCallback(event);
217:     }
218:   }
219: 
220:   /**
221:    * Registers a callback to notify when status of the player manager changes.
222:    */
223:   onStatusUpdate(f: (event: PlayerManagerStatus) => void): void {
224:     this.onStatusUpdateCallback = f;
225:   }
